prompt:
Codex image tool, transparent_background: true, one call for the whole 3x3 sheet (design/mascot/prompts/web-story.txt), registered on the directions sheet's centre cell into this atlas by design/mascot/web-atlas.py. Prompt: The first attached image is a 3x3 head-direction sprite sheet of Kaatu; the second is the approved concept still of the same character. Produce a MATCHING 3x3 sheet for that same character. The character is Kaatu, a cute chubby young beaver mascot: warm deep-amber fur (#DD8636, with a darker amber shade #BE6A22), a soft cream (#F6EBDD) muzzle, two big rounded cream buck teeth, a small rose-pink (#F26A90) nose, soft rose cheek circles, very small rounded ears set low on the sides of the head with rose-brown inner ears, small dark chocolate bead eyes each with a tiny white highlight, a wide, soft, slightly flat-topped head with full round cheeks, a neat flat ring collar of four short rounded segments with small gaps (left to right across the front: teal #3CC2B4, marigold #FAAB3F, rose #F26A90, soft violet #9E8CF4), a seated round body with ONE clean cream (#F6EBDD) oval tummy patch that nothing covers, two short chubby amber ARMS hanging relaxed down the two SIDES of the body, each ending in a small rounded amber paw resting against the hip with tiny finger notches (nothing is ever held in front of the chest), and a chocolate-brown (#7A4A2E) flat paddle tail peeking up behind one hip, never reaching past the side of the head. Copy the character from the attached image exactly: the same colours, the same cream muzzle and buck teeth, the same rose nose and cheeks, the same small low ears, the same four-segment collar, the same round body and clean tummy oval, the same arms and paws, the same peeking tail, the same flat outline-free style. Do not restyle, simplify or redraw it. Flat vector illustration in a modern, friendly app-mascot style: built only from simple soft rounded shapes, with NO outlines and NO strokes anywhere. Flat solid colour fills; each colour has exactly one soft, slightly darker shade shape for gentle depth. No gradients, no texture, no glossy highlights except one tiny white highlight in each eye. Very cute and expressive, with clear, simple face shapes that read at small sizes. Polished and distinctive, like a well-designed brand mascot, not clip art. Match the attached reference images exactly.

This sheet is NINE STORY POSES, for a website about making short videos. The seated lower body (seat, round body, tummy patch), the collar and the tail are the SAME drawing in the SAME position as the centre cell of the attached head-direction sheet in every cell, unless a cell says the body leans; only the face, the head tilt where a cell says so, the arms and paws, and a small prop or symbol change. When an arm is raised, the shoulder still starts at the same place on the body. A prop is a simple flat shape in the palette, with NO letters, NO words, NO numbers, NO logos and NO screen content anywhere. Every prop and both paws stay ABOVE the seat: nothing hangs below the bottom of the body. Keep the collar visible in every cell.

The nine poses, left to right, top to bottom:
1. Peek from the left: Kaatu peeks round an edge on the viewer's LEFT: the head and upper body lean about 18 degrees to the viewer's RIGHT, one paw raised on the left side at head height gripping an unseen edge, the other arm down the side; eyes wide and curious, a small smile, the ears perked.
2. Peek from below: Kaatu peeks up over an unseen ledge: both paws rest flat side by side just under the chin as if holding the ledge's edge, the eyes looking UP, wide and curious, a small smile, the ears perked.
3. Nap: asleep sitting up, the head tilted and resting on a small rounded rectangle pillow shaped like a video clip (a flat soft teal #3CC2B4 tile with rounded corners) hugged against the cheek with both paws; eyes closed in peaceful arcs, a tiny smile; one small flat soft violet (#9E8CF4) crescent moon floating above the head.
4. Carry strip: one arm raised to grip a long film strip resting over the shoulder, the strip running diagonally up behind the head and down behind the back (a chocolate #4A2E22 strip with small cream square holes along both edges and three frames of flat teal, marigold and rose colour); eyes bright and determined, a small proud smile.
5. Jump: a star jump: both arms flung out wide to the sides above shoulder height, the paws open; the ears perked, the eyes wide and sparkling, the mouth open in an excited whee; two tiny marigold (#FAAB3F) motion ticks beside each raised paw.
6. Laptop: one paw holds up a small open laptop beside the body, turned so its screen faces the viewer, the screen a plain flat soft violet (#9E8CF4) panel with nothing on it; the other paw points at the screen; eyes bright, a proud open smile.
7. Search: one paw holds a magnifying glass (a teal #3CC2B4 rim, a pale cream lens, a chocolate #4A2E22 handle) up in front of one eye, that eye drawn larger through the lens; the other eye squinting, the head leaning forward a little, curious.
8. Heart hands: both paws raised in front of the upper chest, their tips touching to make a heart shape between them; eyes closed in happy arcs, the rose cheeks a little bigger; one small flat rose (#F26A90) heart floating above the head.
9. Big wave: one arm stretched high above the head waving wide, the paw open, two tiny marigold (#FAAB3F) motion ticks beside it; the other paw cupped beside the mouth as if calling hello; mouth open, eyes bright.

CRITICAL: same art style, same palette, same proportions, and EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND POSITION IN THE CELL as the attached head-direction sheet. The collar, the body, the tummy patch, the tail and the seat must be the same drawing, the same width, and the same height off the bottom of the cell as in the attached sheet, identical in all nine cells here. If the sheets do not line up the character visibly jumps when the animation switches between them, so match them.

Wide margin on all four sides; nothing touches or crosses a cell edge, including raised paws, props and floating symbols, and keep clear empty space below the body. Any floating symbol is SMALL, FLAT (no outline, no gradient) and sits entirely inside its OWN cell, close beside or just above the head.

No text, no labels, no borders, no drop shadows, no background colour.
Square image, at least 1024x1024, PNG WITH A REAL ALPHA CHANNEL. The background must be genuinely transparent, not white.
